lesson: A merge that conflicts on .factory recorded state wedges the session twice: first the hook itself crashes while factory_lib.py carries conflict markers (every write tool fail-closed; recovery = fix the file from a healthy sibling worktree via EnterWorktree), then the recovered hook rightly refuses git rm/add on .factory paths even though merge resolution of recorder-produced content is not hand-writing. There is no forge command for resolving .factory merge conflicts; the human had to run the git rm/add lines. Candidate FORGE-ACC-3 scope: a 'forge merge resolve' that takes ours/theirs per recorded file with schema validation, and a hook exemption scoped to unmerged-index paths.
